diff.content:
diff --git a/registry/client.py b/registry/client.py
--- a/registry/client.py
+++ b/registry/client.py
@@ -20,4 +20,12 @@ class Record:
     identifier: str
     status: str
 
 
+class _QueueMessageOps:
+    \"\"\"Queue message operations, threading root and cwd through every call.\"\"\"
+
+    def enqueue(self, message, *, registry_root, cwd):
+        return run_cli("enqueue", message, root=registry_root, cwd=cwd)
+
+    def drain(self, *, registry_root, cwd):
+        return run_cli("drain", root=registry_root, cwd=cwd)
diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
--- a/tests/test_client.py
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -10,2 +10,9 @@ def test_record_mutation_ops_close_calls_run_cli():
     ops.close("r-1", registry_root=ROOT, cwd=CWD)
     assert last_run_cli_call().kwargs["root"] == ROOT
+
+
+def test_queue_message_ops_enqueue_threads_root_and_cwd():
+    ops = _QueueMessageOps()
+    ops.enqueue({"kind": "sync"}, registry_root=ROOT, cwd=CWD)
+    assert last_run_cli_call().kwargs["root"] == ROOT
+    assert last_run_cli_call().kwargs["cwd"] == CWD

change_contract.goal: Add queue message operations (enqueue, drain) to the registry client.
acceptance_criteria: Queue messages can be enqueued and drained through the registry client.
The new operations reach the registry through the existing transport.

repository_instructions.label: Client layering rules
repository_instructions.summary: When one caller already threads a root and working directory through every method of a client, a second client added for a different operation family should not repeat the same threading - converge on one client already bound to those values.

data: `registry/client.py` already defines `_TransportSession`, bound to `registry_root` and `cwd` at construction, calling `run_cli` through `self._call`. This diff does not touch it.

`registry/client.py` also already defines `_RecordMutationOps`, whose `create`/`update`/`close` methods each take `registry_root` and `cwd` as parameters rather than using the already-bound transport session. This diff does not touch it either.
All client classes in this module call the same underlying `run_cli` transport function.
operational: Every runtime module that calls the registry constructs its own root/cwd pair from the same two configuration values.
